note: Twelve concrete near-term actions for theoretical computer science, agreed by 32 participants and informed by a 134-response survey: AI methodology sections in papers, conference rules, hiring based on candidates’ three best works and in-depth interviews, more postdocs, AI-free training in PhD programmes, and encouraging grants to cover reasonable LLM costs. The report is linked from the working group page.
title: AI and TCS: The Next Six Months (working group report)
who: Simons Institute working group; organisers Tony Feng, Zeph Landau, Amit Sahai, Nikhil Srivastava
